# SaltWatch 2.2.6

This maintenance release aligns the official SaltWatch firmware with the
current ESPHome release used by Home Assistant.

## Aligned firmware versions

- Updated the validated and published firmware toolchain from ESPHome 2026.8.2
  to ESPHome 2026.9.0.
- Prevented the official SaltWatch update from immediately making Home
  Assistant offer a second ESPHome Device Builder firmware update solely
  because the two images were built with different ESPHome versions.

There are no measurement, calibration, forecast, or connectivity behavior
changes in this release. Existing Wi-Fi credentials, Home Assistant API
encryption, calibration, and forecast data are preserved during the managed
update.
